name: sample/manual-route — the same supervisor, fully deterministic
description: A route node with the 'manual' decider: config.pinned names the branch that ALWAYS runs, zero LLM calls on the hop (a node budget of 0 is offline mode by construction). Same choice-set wiring rules as the llm decider — options keys must equal the downstream ids, 'fallback' must be in the set. Use it to pin a graph for debugging, testing, or to exercise one branch of a larger design graph without burning model budget. 'rule' is reserved (validator rejects it).
